title: The waiting page's remaining narrow-screen faults that #2450 leaves out are fixed
why: Coordinator 11:36 CST Nov 9, from lane page-narrow-word-breaks (#2450): #2450 fixes part of step page-narrow-word-breaks and leaves these out: the .dcap caption size; the "(permission|-denied)" failure-line break; the "Question|s" tab labels; the sent panel scrolling 9 px sideways at 180 px (on the base); and part B, words wider than their box. Harm: the owner reads the page on a phone, and these still break or cut text at narrow widths with large text.
note: Part B keeps the a11y.md rule. Measurements for each item are on step page-narrow-word-breaks. A screen lane: designer first, design reviewer after. Fix pick for the tab breaks (lane notes-fix-page 11:47 CST Nov 9, from #2423 design review round 2, 11:46): words that fit still break because the count chip shares the flex row; `.tabs a { flex-wrap: wrap; }` drops the chip to its own line. A scratch run removed every tab break at 200%, plus "Questions" at 260 px and "Designs" at 210-220 px at 300%; evidence in that lane's scratch folder dr6/out-exp-wrap. The failure line also breaks "denie|d" at 180 px with 200% text and 200-220 px at 300%. With that fix, the other 300% tab breaks remain (lane 11:51 CST); the durable evidence is the measured result above, not the scratch screenshots. The lane re-measures, red test first. Lane notes-fix-page (13:18 CST Nov 9; #2423 round 3 record 6749051555): docs/design/press-row-reflow-notes.md :128-129 gives lone-letter tab ranges that differ at integer widths. "Question|s" at 200% shows at 183-200 px (the notes say 190-200), and "Design|s" at 300% at 205-230 px (the notes say 210-230). Line 189: "Questions" at 300% breaks at 236-249 px because of the tab padding and border (14 px), not the chip. Lines 136-138 (head third row) and 150-151 (bar status) hold only on their sample grid. This step changes the tab layout, so it re-measures these lines at integer widths. Finding from lane notes-fix-page (#2347), relayed 22:56 CST Nov 9: at 300% text and 390 px or less, or 200% text and 280 px or less, "Show answer" overruns its row and the page scrolls sideways. Drop it here if #2347's redesign covers it. Finding from lane notes-fix-page, 23:25 CST Nov 9: at 180 px wide with 200% text the page scrolls sideways, from the dismissed fold, the open card head, the text box and the parked presses (not the rows).
